item.title: Gateway School District’s annual exhibit to shine light on students’ creativity during Youth Art Month
item.description: Monroeville Public Library’s Elaine Biondi Gallery Space will be filled with local talent Feb. 27-March 24 during Gateway School District’s annual art show. The exhibit will include artwork created by students from kindergarten through 12 grade.

item.title: Leetsdale, Leet and Bell Acres firefighters start official merger talks
item.description: Three Quaker Valley area fire departments have begun formal merger talks in order to boost manpower and service capabilities.

item.title: Communities call in the heavy machinery for snow removal
item.description: Some towns are trading in their snowplows for front loaders and dump trucks to deal with the remnants of Sunday’s snowstorm.

item.title: The Stroller, Jan. 29, 2026: Events in the Alle-Kiski Valley
item.description: Publicize your non-profit’s community events, fundraisers and club meetings for free in The Stroller. Send information at least two weeks in advance to vndnews@triblive.com or The Stroller, 210 Wood St., Tarentum PA 15084. Please include a daytime telephone number. item.title: Plans are underway to improve signage, lighting and pedestrian access near Westmoreland Mall
item.description: Hempfield wants to spruce up the Westmore­land Mall area by adding signage, lighting and pedestrian improvements at the entrance into the township.

item.title: U mad, bro?: Steelers fans are angry over the hiring of Mike McCarthy, media coverage of the hire — or both
item.description: Everybody in Pittsburgh has been in a snit over one big topic all week.

item.title: Democratic Sen. Klobuchar says she’s running for Minnesota governor after Gov. Walz dropped out
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS (AP) — U.S. Sen. Amy Klobuchar said Thursday she is running for governor of Minnesota, promising to take on President Donald Trump while unifying a state that has endured a series of challenges even before the federal government’s immigration crackdown.

item.title: FBI raid in Georgia highlights Trump’s 2020 election obsession and hints at possible future actions
item.description: DENVER — Donald Trump lost his bid for reelection in 2020. But for more than five years, he’s been trying to convince Americans the opposite is true by falsely saying the election was marred by widespread fraud.

item.title: Worries deepen in U.S. South after days of grappling with snow, ice and widespread outages
item.description: JACKSON, Miss. — Conditions were growing more dire in parts of the South still reeling from subfreezing temperatures and widespread power outages as vehicles got stranded for hours on major highways and officials warned Wednesday that people stuck at home were running out of food, medicine and other essentials.

item.title: New videos show Alex Pretti scuffle with federal officers in Minneapolis 11 days before his death
item.description: WASHINGTON — Alex Pretti was forcefully taken to the ground by federal immigration agents after kicking out the tail light of their vehicle during a Minneapolis protest 11 days before he was shot and killed by Border Patrol officers, videos that emerged Wednesday show.
